home.metaTitle: Life coaching, online and in Kitchener–Waterloo — Fareed Quraishi
home.metaDescription: One-to-one life coaching for career transitions, feeling stuck, or questioning what comes next — online or in person. Begin with a 15-minute call.

hero.eyebrow: Life coaching · One-to-one · Online and in person
hero.title: You’ve worked hard to build your life. Are you getting to live it?
hero.lede: Whether you’re navigating a career transition, feeling stuck, or questioning what comes next, coaching offers a space to reconnect with what matters and move forward with greater clarity and intention.

image.alt: Fareed Quraishi standing outdoors in a jacket against an open sky.

items.name: One-to-one, and unhurried
items.body: We meet individually, for an hour, with no script and no questionnaire to complete beforehand.

items.name: Reflective conversation and self-exploration
items.body: The work happens in talking and noticing: what you want, what you are carrying, and what gets in the way.

items.name: Recognising patterns and what to change
items.body: We look at what happens under pressure, what it has been protecting, and where a real change is possible.

items.name: Online or in person
items.body: Sessions are available by video call wherever you are, or in person when that is practical.

items.name: Personal and collaborative
items.body: It is shaped by your circumstances rather than by a fixed programme. You keep authority over your own direction.

link.label: What coaching involves, and what it costs

invite.label: An invitation
invite.title: You don’t need to have it figured out to start.
invite.body: Most people arrive with a sentence along the lines of: something isn’t working, and I can’t quite say what. That is a good enough place to begin. The first step is a short conversation — 15 minutes on the phone.
invite.second: I’m welcoming a limited number of clients into my inaugural coaching program, with introductory pricing available while spaces remain.
invite.note: Nothing is booked or charged by sending the request, and it commits you to nothing. If we do decide to work together, the practical terms reach you in writing before anything is paid.
